capabilities: Analyze selected text with a local Ollama LLM
Highlight grammar errors with red underlines
Suggest C1-C2 style improvements with blue underlines
Accept inline suggestion chips with one click
extras: Requires a locally running Ollama server with a specific model pulled (gemma3:4b or gemma3:12b); install is manual by copying files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in grammar or proficiency-level writing feedback, and cloud-based checkers send text off-device.
summary: Real-time English writing checker that flags grammar errors and style suggestions in the editor using a local Ollama LLM.
